# heic-to 1.5.2

`heic-to-1.5.2.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/heic-to.min.js` from the
heic-to 1.5.2 npm release. It contains libheif 1.22.2 and its bundled decoder.
License: LGPL-3.0; see LICENSE.txt.

Upstream source and build instructions: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
Exact release: https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.5.2.tgz
libheif source: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.22.2

This separately loaded module can be replaced with a compatible implementation.
Yap does not send images to any third-party conversion service.
